blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Repair the authored cemetery's camera/spatial and exposure contracts using binding/isolation changes, deliver the required authored choice hierarchy, and make the ordinary run/result/retry lifecycle closure-ready for Tester recapture.

diagnosis.root_cause: The retained authored cemetery is present, but camera coverage still treats GroundCollision/MausoleumCollision as visual blockers (Warden 0.60, mausoleum 0.40), while the shipped lighting/composition remains too dark for readable silhouettes and landmarks. Prior camera treatments repeatedly tuned transforms without isolating the occlusion binding or proving the complete route. The release ledger and shell also need a same-loop completion pass that preserves authoritative state through result, retry, and title transitions.

stop_conditions: Do not replace, split, hide, duplicate, or reposition the preserved authored cemetery package or its native landmarks.
Do not claim gap closure from source checks, qualification journals, or synthetic diagnostic rows; Tester must recapture the bound runtime route and result matrix.
Keep changes within the three bounded task families and preserve native_godot_project and host_godot_boot baselines.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause approach from repeated transform tuning: repair camera/world occlusion binding and explicit sight-lane isolation, rebalance the existing authored light hierarchy rather than replacing assets, then harden the existing authoritative run ledger and shell transaction. Fold the mandatory visual choice capability into the presentation task with truthful icon-led cards and input focus states.

code: Run the candidate's native project checks and targeted parser/resource-load checks for all edited scenes/scripts.

White-box inspect camera occlusion binding, cemetery collision alignment, upgrade presenter payload normalization, and ledger terminal idempotence; confirm no preserved authored hierarchy was split or replaced.
runtime: Tester recaptures the spatial route matrix (spawn, near-contact, departure, perimeter/cardinal) with camera coverage and runtime state, then runs the ordinary five-wave/Bellkeeper route and result/retry/title matrix.

Tester verifies authoritative XP/upgrade transaction receipts, exactly-once terminal/result commits, clean reset generations, and three distinct successful build-shape rows; diagnostic fixtures do not qualify.
Tester exercises keyboard, mouse, and gamepad draft focus/confirm paths and checks settings/input context after pause, result, retry, and title transitions.
visual: Capture shipped 1280px gameplay frames at spawn, critical route, dense combat, cardinal landmarks, and perimeter; compare warm lantern versus cool moonlight hierarchy, silhouettes, escape lanes, and absence of camera occlusion to the bound reference.

Capture the level-up draft over the treated gameplay/pause backdrop and verify icon-led hierarchy, truthful current-to-new values (maximum three deltas), and distinct focus/hover/pressed/unavailable/selected states without opaque debug-like panels.

done_when: The shipped high-angle Camera3D keeps the Warden and mausoleum readable at spawn, near-contact, departure, and perimeter cells, with no persistent occlusion and a visible escape lane.

A larger traversable scale is available around the central building while the external world/external depth remains visible; native collision agrees with visible geometry and does not create invisible barriers.

Camera-aware occluder handling isolates GroundCollision/MausoleumCollision (or equivalent non-visual blockers) from gameplay sight queries without weakening player collision; no player or landmark disappearance/occlusion occurs during ordinary movement or a movement replay.
The cemetery boundary/perimeter remains coherent, traversal stays inside the authored map, and the Warden never passes through landmark collision.
The task explicitly preserves the intact authored map and uses binding/isolation or authored sight lanes instead of another camera transform-only adjustment.
tasks.instructions: Repair the camera/world integration at the binding layer. Inspect ArenaCamera, cemetery spatial contract, and native cemetery collision; separate camera visibility/occlusion treatment from gameplay collision, add only the minimum authored sight-lane or blocker isolation needed, and verify player/landmark framing through the complete route. The spatial capability must cover expand or larger traversable scale, external world or external depth, central building or landmark, collision, disappearance or occlusion, boundary or perimeter, and ordinary movement or movement replay. Do not replace the preserved environment or tune child meshes independently.
tasks.title: Restore camera and arena spatial integrity via binding isolation

done_when: The authored cemetery reads with blue-violet moonlit shadows, warm player/landmark lantern accents, readable Warden silhouette, hostile telegraph contrast, and visible escape lanes at spawn, critical route, dense combat, and cardinal/perimeter views.
Exposure is corrected through the existing world/environment/light/material bindings without flattening hostile teal/magenta cues or introducing large opaque fill planes.

Upgrade cards lead with a recognizable weapon/upgrade silhouette or authored icon, compact stat icons, and no more than three decision-relevant truthful current-to-new deltas; unchanged, NEW, LOCKED, and unrelated rows are omitted from current values.

The three-card draft has distinct keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/hover/pressed/unavailable/selected states, debounced confirm, stable card dimensions, and remains legible over the treated pause backdrop.
The presentation remains bespoke to Mournlight and is retestable in the shipped gameplay camera at the configured native viewport and supported UI scale.
tasks.instructions: Rebalance the retained cemetery's lighting/exposure and landmark accents as a presentation binding repair, not an asset replacement. Compare the runtime frame to the bound effect-imagination reference for warm-versus-cool hierarchy, readable silhouettes, compact HUD, and clear lanes. In the same presentation family, finish or correct the upgrade-draft visual hierarchy so every choice communicates identity and truthful before-to-after values with complete input focus states; keep authoritative eligibility and stacking data untouched unless a directly related presenter adapter is wrong.
tasks.title: Restore moonlit composition and authored upgrade-choice hierarchy

done_when: A fresh title-to-Play ordinary run enters a clean active state, progresses through five data-driven waves including the Bellkeeper final wave, and reaches a result screen without stale actors, timers, pause ownership, audio, or UI.
Result presents truthful victory/failure, time, level, defeated enemies, damage dealt/taken, selected upgrades, and build summary; terminal commit and result presentation occur exactly once.
Retry from Result starts a new clean run with reset authoritative counters, inventory, pickups, boss/director state, audio, focus, and input context; Return to Title then Play is equally clean.

CompleteRunLedger records ordinary wave order, draft choices, boss events, terminal/result/retry/title milestones, rejects diagnostic fixtures from ordinary qualification, and preserves overflow XP and exactly-once upgrade transactions.

Tester can independently exercise failure→Result→Retry, victory→Result→Replay/Retry, Credits & Notices, and the three distinct successful build-shape cells through the existing authoritative gameplay APIs.
tasks.instructions: Harden the existing run controller, complete-run ledger, and shell transaction boundaries. Audit every terminal, result, retry, title, credits, pause, and audio/input-context handoff for idempotence and clean disposal; repair only directly related lifecycle seams. Keep ordinary successful routes distinct from diagnostic preparation and ensure the result payload is sourced from authoritative snapshots. Do not broaden into deferred dense-performance or automatic-audio work.
tasks.title: Close ordinary run, result, retry, and title lifecycle contract
